shortDescription: The FTSE MIB Index dropped 74 points or 0.14 percent on Tuesday to close at 51555 points.Losses were led by UniCredit (-2.34%), Moncler (-1.69%) and Bper Banca (-1.66%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Tenaris (3.34%), Terna Rete Elettrica Nazionale (2.76%) and Saipem (1.76%).

children: The FTSE MIB Index dropped 74 points or 0.14 percent on Tuesday to close at 51555 points.
Losses were led by UniCredit (-2.34%), Moncler (-1.69%) and Bper Banca (-1.66%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Tenaris (3.34%), Terna Rete Elettrica Nazionale (2.76%) and Saipem (1.76%).

title: The FTSE MIB Index Closes 0.14% Lower
